about: core/loop_coverage.py (DEC-0101): every process MIA has, with a loop or a reason. status: todo (needs a loop), proposed (a task drafts it), none (why: no loop needed).

action:alarm.why: alarms set, switched and deleted by hand (Toolbox, DEC-0125): her own clock times, nothing of MIA's to improve

action:app.why: which apps show and which are favourites is their own choice; MIA judges nothing in it

action:browser.why: each held browser step is the person's own yes; one that fails counts in actions.failed, and taught tasks are watched by browser.runs

action:camera.why: removing a camera they added is their own choice; the feed itself is a device, not a decision of hers

action:capture.why: the person keeps or leaves out a recording (DEC-0125); a kept one is a journal entry, which has its own loop

action:comms.why: the person's own settings for how often MIA speaks up (DEC-0129); the communication gate already learns from dismissals and logs every decision

action:connect.why: each import is the person's own ask, previewed and approved; a refused or failed one counts in actions.failed, and every import is undoable

action:energy.why: readings and sources entered by hand (Power, DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:energy_source.why: readings and sources entered by hand (Power, DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:firstboot.why: once per device; the glasses first boot is watched through glasses.voice once it is done

action:lab_reading.why: readings entered by hand in the Lab (DEC-0125): measurements, not her choices; nothing of MIA's to improve

action:listing.why: where a product is listed, entered by hand on the Workshop page or said (DEC-0125): the person's record, not MIA's choice; nothing of hers to improve

action:med.why: the person's medications as written on the label (DEC-0129); MIA never suggests a dose, so nothing to learn here

action:mission_idea.why: the person's yes or no on an idea MIA made (DEC-0125); the mission it becomes has the missions loop, and a set-aside idea is kept as history

action:notification.why: reading and dismissing notifications by hand; a dismissal already teaches the communication gate (its gate.* loops)

action:profile.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

action:record.why: health records kept as given (DEC-0129); never interpreted

action:setting.why: their own settings: nothing MIA chose, so nothing of hers to correct

action:sleep.why: the person's own log of a night (DEC-0129); MIA reads it, never grades it

action:starter.why: a starter set added by the person from Settings or by voice (DEC-0125); what it adds are routines and upkeep, which have their own loops

action:textbook.why: a course made from a book, or a book removed, by the person on the Classroom page or by voice (DEC-0125); the tutor's answers have their own loops

action:undo.why: undo.last puts back the newest change, as "undo that" does; undoing MIA's own change already counts as a correction (core/corrections.py)

action:visit.why: visits as the person records them (DEC-0129); MIA never judges care

action:why.why: the person's own reasons, linked, unlinked or marked achieved by hand on My Why (DEC-0125); MIA never invents a reason, so there's nothing of hers to improve

check:birthday.why: a greeting once a year: there is nothing in how it lands to learn from

check:chronicle_issue.why: Zac approves every issue by hand, and its continuity rules are checked in code before he sees it

check:fix_report.why: it writes the fix report for Claude; the failures it lists are watched by answers.failures

check:rewards.why: it unlocks what the person already earned by rules they can see; it judges nothing of its own

check:seasons_of_memory.why: it keeps a summary of the history once a month; what it says is answered through the seasons plan, watched by the answers.* loops and calibration like every plan

check:self_report.why: it reports the loops: what it says is only as good as they are, and they are watched

store:id_wallet.why: the person's own cards as they give them; MIA reminds before expiry and never reads or uses the numbers

action:art.why: deleting a picture MIA painted is the person's own choice (DEC-0138); nothing of MIA's to improve

store:art.why: the pictures MIA painted on request and what from (DEC-0138); what she paints is the person's taste, and a failed painting is told at once

action:theme.why: a theme the person made or removed is their own taste (DEC-0136); nothing of MIA's to improve

action:wallet.why: taking a card out of the wallet is the person's own choice; nothing of MIA's to improve

store:data_logger.why: readings from meters and sensors: measurements, not her choices (grow_alert speaks when one is out of range)

store:energy.why: readings from meters and sensors: measurements, not her choices (grow_alert speaks when one is out of range)

store:gps_tracks.why: where a person went, from their own GPX files: no MIA behaviour in it to improve yet; its numbers are worked out in code and tested

store:health.why: the person's own health records as they give them (DEC-0129); MIA never grades or interprets them, so there's no work of hers to improve

store:homestead.why: only its setup writes it so far; a loop comes with the first app or action that does

store:intents.why: their reasons in their own words; MIA keeps them and never judges them

store:life_events.why: the history beside the stores, never rewritten; what lands in it is judged by the loops of the stores that write it

store:links.why: how things relate, stated by people or derived from records: as good as the records, which have their own loops

store:lite_captures.why: their own notes and scripts, kept as they wrote them: MIA writes none of it

store:net_worth.why: a reading of net worth once a day, worked out in code from the accounts and properties: a measurement, not her choices

store:online_reminders.why: a list they asked for, delivered whole the moment the connection returns: nothing is chosen or timed, so nothing to learn from

store:personal_life_events.why: the history beside the stores, never rewritten; what lands in it is judged by the loops of the stores that write it

store:plans.why: a shelf of references the household keeps; a structure she can't work out a material list for is logged as no_tool and watched by gaps.repeated

store:scripts.why: their own notes and scripts, kept as they wrote them: MIA writes none of it

store:textbooks.why: the books and chapters they added; the tutor keeps no quiz answers to grade, so there is nothing to measure until it records them
